# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the EXACT tasks you broke/fixed) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — type-contract + formula-recalc + anti-fabrication (4 additive edits)
- Changes I made (1 line per edit; file + cluster):
  1. task_template.md "Match the expected TYPE": added the scorer's OWN dual rule — TEXT answer → keep string, don't parse into number/date/bool; NUMBER/DATE answer → real int/float/datetime, not its text form; when unsure copy the column's example type. (Cluster: type contract — 50630, 57232, 56427, 51958, 55931.)
  2. task_template.md: new "Formulas are graded by RECALCULATED value" block — plain cell formulas OK/keep; array(ArrayFormula)/dynamic(UNIQUE/FILTER/SORT)/TEXTJOIN/AGGREGATE/volatile(RAND/NOW/TODAY) don't recalc headlessly → write literal; ""→blank lowers coverage. (Cluster: live-formula — 53367, 47741, 56637, 59743; 56996 unwinnable.)
  3. task_template.md verify step 3: turned it into a MUST-pass checklist — (b) type mismatch = failure→rewrite, (c) recompute formula recalc value not text, (d) reproduce any worked-example value exactly or the rule is wrong. (Structural reinforcement of clusters 1–3.)
  4. prompt.md: anti-fabrication bullet — apply only stated operations; don't invent ÷/strip/reformat; reproduce the worked example. (Cluster: fabricated criterion — 11842, 5192; helps 39046, 51359.)
- EXPECTED effect + why safe: fixes the ~5 pure type-contract tasks (value already right, only type wrong) and the array/exotic-formula recalc tasks; all edits ADDITIVE/BOUNDED clarifications of the value+type contract. No global decision/permission rule touched. Blast radius checked: 4 passing formula tasks (CF_11072 cond-format, 55060 IF, 55667 INDEX/SUMPRODUCT, 58109 SUMIFS/WORKDAY) use none of the "won't-recalc" funcs and plain formulas are explicitly kept → no forced literalization of per-copy-tracking formulas; datetime-passers 110-2/41297 keep dates; text-passers keep str.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none (first iteration off seed). Honored auto-memory traps: no blanket strip (rule is provenance/semantic), no formula ban (kept plain-formula guidance, only redirected non-recalc funcs), used the LibreOffice recalc exotic-func fact.
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: genuine logic/criterion & reference-quirk failures — 3911 (ambiguous allocation, fails preview copy), 30709 (Excel locale DATEVALUE quirk in GT), 325-44/450-9 (exact expansion/label-sequence semantics), 57090 (dedup rule), 59259 (2/3 near-miss). Not prose-fixable without hardcoding gold; left to structural example-reproduction check only.
- Plateau signal: n/a (first step). If type/formula edits accept but hard-logic cluster stays, next lever is NOT more prose — consider per-task-class worked procedures only where a general rule exists.
- Focus next iteration: re-diagnose remaining failures after this batch; check whether the type-contract edit fixed the 5 pure-type tasks; if formula edits didn't move 53367/47741, the array-recalc hypothesis is wrong — investigate the actual recalc output.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.580 Δ=+0.000 · fixed={47741, 59259} · broke={50051, 73-45}. — its WHOLE batch was reverted; re-introduce only the edits that did NOT break a task above, dropping/redesigning the ones that did.
<!-- cand_0001: rejected val=0.580 Δ=+0.000 -->

## Iteration cand_0002 — reintroduce ONLY cand_0001's non-regressing edits + 3 new operation-scoped contract rules
- Changes I made (all in task_template.md; prompt.md untouched):
  1. Recalc-to-literal block (cluster: formula won't recalc — 53367 ArrayFormula, 47741 _xlfn/TEXTJOIN). Re-introduced verbatim-in-spirit from cand_0001 (it fixed 47741, broke nothing).
  2. Reuse-existing-pattern block with a broken-formula EXCEPTION (cluster: 56637 regressed off the correct in-sheet =IF, 59259 added an extra date-bound the visible SUMIFS lacks).
  3. Type-by-OPERATION bullets: copy/lookup->keep source type (57232); split/extract->keep str (50630); convert/standardize->real datetime+number_format (51958).
  4. Don't-invent-#N/A/'-'/blank clause, converse of the seed's "use the named form" rule (55931).
  5. Verify step reissued as a-b-c checklist: recalc-value + reproduce-existing-example precondition; (a) keeps rich-text types. Dropped cand_0001's str-where-number "FAILURE" recheck.
- Per change — expected effect + why safe: fixes clusters 1-4 above (each an ADDITIVE contract
  clarification firing only under a stated operation/condition). 73-45 protected (type rules
  scoped to copy/split/convert, none apply to rich-text; rich-text bullet + verify(a) kept).
  50051 protected (no anti-fabrication rule re-added; reuse-pattern EXCEPTION = "fix the broken
  formula, don't copy its stale value"). Plain-formula passers 55060/55667/58109 recalc fine and
  are explicitly kept; CF_11072/110-2 formatting/filter answers untouched.
- Building on prior RESULTS: cand_0001 fixed={47741,59259} — I re-added the recalc block +
  example-repro check that produced those. cand_0001 broke={50051,73-45} — I did NOT re-add the
  two culprits (prompt.md anti-fabrication bullet; global "TEXT answer stays a plain string"
  rule + str-where-number verify recheck). Regression root-cause verified by a dedicated
  subagent reading 50051/73-45 traces.
- Refuted hypotheses (never re-test): global anti-fabrication prose (breaks corrective
  re-derivations, 50051); unscoped "text answer -> plain string" type rule (flattens rich text,
  73-45).
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: ambiguous/inconsistent-reference tasks (325-44, 450-9,
  38332, 39046, 5192, 51359, 3911, 30709, 57090, 56996, 11842, 59743) — GT not reconstructable
  from visible data; not prose-fixable without hardcoding gold. Left alone.
- Plateau signal: cand_0001 was net-zero (fixed 2 / broke 2). This iteration keeps the 2 fixes,
  removes the 2 breaks, and adds 4 fresh clean clusters (57232, 50630, 51958, 55931 + 56637) —
  aiming for clear net-positive. If this rejects, the next lever is NOT more contract prose;
  the remaining failures are reference-ambiguity, which prose cannot address.
- Focus next iteration: if accepted, re-diagnose which of {57232,50630,51958,55931,56637,53367}
  actually flipped; if any type rule didn't move its task, the operation discriminator is still
  too coarse for the reader — add a worked example rather than more prose.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.600 Δ=+0.020 · fixed={47741, 51958, 59259} · broke={50051, 73-45}.
<!-- cand_0002: ACCEPTED val=0.600 Δ=+0.020 -->

## Iteration cand_0003 — pivot the lever: STRUCTURE (reconcile all 3 copies + coverage) + 3 scoped KNOWLEDGE rules
- Changes I made (all in task_template.md; prompt.md untouched):
  1. Edit A (verify sub-step c, rewritten): reproduce EVERY worked example on EVERY of the three
     on-disk copies, not just the previewed one; a rule that fits copy 1 but not 2/3 is WRONG →
     recompute (don't copy pre-filled values). (Cluster 1: overfit-to-copy-1 / passes 1/3.)
  2. Edit D (verify sub-step d, new): no required cell may be left None/""; an outer IF(...,"")
     that can evaluate to "" is a bug → return the real value; exempts intentionally-blank cells.
     (Cluster 2: coverage holes.)
  3. Edit B1 (Reuse-the-answer-pattern, appended bullet): if the sheet already computes the SAME
     statistic in an adjacent/helper/summary formula, reference/replicate THAT rather than
     re-counting raw cells in Python (Python vs Excel equality diverges). (Cluster 3: hand-rolled
     recount ≠ reference.)
  4. Edit C (split/extract bullet, extended): extracted pieces stay str EVEN WHEN a pre-filled
     example cell holds a real datetime/number — the operation dictates output type. (Cluster 4.)
  5. Edit B2 (new bullet by the don't-invent-#N/A converse): normalize both sides of a text-key
     match (trim incl. \xa0, collapse double spaces, straighten curly quotes/apostrophes); a miss
     after normalizing is not a licence to emit #N/A/"-"/blank. (Cluster 5: 55931.)
- Expected effect + why safe: Edit A/D are STRUCTURE — they only add work on tasks that currently
  fail on hidden copies / leave holes; the 30 passers already reproduce all 3 copies (pass 3/3)
  and don't leave required cells blank, so their behavior is unchanged. B1/C/B2 are BOUNDED
  KNOWLEDGE rules firing only under a stated condition (in-sheet summary formula present /
  split-extract op / text-key match miss). No global decision rule; prompt.md untouched.
- Building on prior RESULTS: kept ALL of cand_0002's accepted contract prose as the base (it
  fixed {47741,51958,59259}); this iteration is purely additive on top. Did NOT re-add prompt.md
  anti-fabrication prose (broke 50051) nor any global "text→plain string" rule (broke 73-45).
- Refuted hypotheses (never re-test): global anti-fabrication prose in prompt.md (50051); unscoped
  "text answer → plain string" (73-45); AND — new this iter — MORE type-contract prose alone: it
  did NOT move 57232/50630/53367/55931/56637/56427, hence the pivot to STRUCTURE.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: reference-ambiguity / unrecoverable (5192, 30709, 56996,
  325-44, 450-9, 53367, 3911) — GT not reconstructable from visible data; deliberately skipped to
  avoid overfitting.
- Plateau signal: cand_0002 accepted (+0.020) but its type prose plateaued on the above 6 tasks.
  Lever switched from "clarify the type contract" to "force cross-copy reconciliation + coverage
  at verify time" (STRUCTURE). If cand_0003 rejects or is flat, the next lever is a per-class
  WORKED EXAMPLE (concrete input→output) rather than another prose rule, since the reader
  (gpt-5.5) may need a demonstration where an abstract rule didn't land.
- Environment fault handed back: 73-45 (LibreOffice recalc failure — infra, not capability).
- Focus next iteration: after re-score, check whether Edit A flipped any of the overfit/passes-1/3
  tasks; if the STRUCTURE edits didn't move them, add a worked example for the top cluster.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.660 Δ=+0.060 · fixed={38332, 50630, 73-45} · broke={—}.
<!-- cand_0003: ACCEPTED val=0.660 Δ=+0.060 -->

## Iteration cand_0004 — NARROW the over-firing split→str rule + CONSOLIDATE the recalc rule + bounded int/float type
- Changes I made (all in task_template.md; prompt.md untouched):
  1. Edit 1 (split/extract bullet, rewritten + EXCEPTION): the "extracted piece stays str" default
     now applies only to generic "parts/sections" the instruction does NOT name as a typed value;
     ADDED exception — when the instruction's OWN request names the result a date/time/number/id/
     count, produce the real datetime/float/int. Keyed on what the instruction asks to PRODUCE,
     not on a date/number in a header/source/example cell. (Cluster: 325-44 str-where-int ids,
     30709 str-where-datetime dates — both CAUSED by cand_0003's edit C.)
  2. Edit 2 (recalc block, rewritten): literalize ONLY when the answer cell's OWN formula is a
     non-recalcing type (array/CSE, UNIQUE/FILTER/SORT, TEXTJOIN, AGGREGATE). Do NOT literalize
     because a cell it READS is volatile/formula-driven — if the instruction asks to PUT/FIX a
     formula or the answer looks up volatile/formula-driven cells, keep a LIVE ordinary formula so
     it recalcs in lockstep with the reference. (Cluster: 56996 VLOOKUP into RANDBETWEEN matrix
     snapshotted stale; 53367 discarded correct live SUMPRODUCT for a Python bool.)
  3. Edit 3 (type-matching section, new bullet): Excel/recalc numbers are floats; when a worked-
     example/reference cell in the range holds a whole number as a float (28.0, 66.0), write the
     computed answer as a float too. (Cluster: 56427 int/str-where-float; reinforces 57232, 50051.)
- Per change — expected effect + why safe:
  - Edit 1 NARROWS cand_0003's edit C. Blast radius verified against the passing anchor 50630
    ("split a sentence into three PARTS" → generic → str is gold, keeps trailing \xa0), which the
    reworded default preserves. Discriminators (b) "looks numeric/date" and (c) "substring vs
    whole-field" were tested and REJECTED (each misclassifies 50630 or 325-44). No passing task
    extracts an instruction-named date/number yet keeps str.
  - Edit 2 CONSOLIDATES the recalc block. 47741 (passing) still literalizes because TEXTJOIN is a
    non-recalcing TYPE; plain-formula passers 55060/55667/58109/CF_11072 already keep live formulas
    → reinforced. No passing task snapshots a volatile source.
  - Edit 3 fires ONLY when an example/reference cell is a float → flips int-where-float failures
    only; int-example count tasks (39046 F) keep int.
- Building on prior RESULTS: kept ALL of cand_0003's accepted edits as the base. Edit 1 fixes a
  SELF-INFLICTED conflict from cand_0003 edit C (the over-broad str rule). Did NOT re-add prompt.md
  anti-fabrication prose (broke 50051, cand_0001) nor a global "text→plain string" rule (broke
  73-45, cand_0001/0002).
- Refuted hypotheses (never re-test): global anti-fabrication prose in prompt.md (50051); unscoped
  "text answer → plain string" (73-45); MORE type-contract prose alone (cand_0003 showed it
  plateaued). NEW this iter, to confirm at re-score: split/extract type is governed by the
  INSTRUCTION's named target, NOT by "operation always dictates str" (cand_0003's edit C was too
  strong).
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: reference-ambiguity / inconsistent-gold — 5192 & 450-9
  (contradictory/hand-authored gold), 39046/51359/3911 (identical inputs → different pre-filled
  answers across copies; non-unique allocation). Provably not prose-fixable without hardcoding.
  11842/55931 have their governing rule already present (agent skips it — behavioral, out of scope).
  56637 deferred (cand_0002 regression history + UNBOUNDED range-semantics fix).
- Plateau signal: cand_0003 (+0.060) was strong; this iteration keeps its lever momentum but the
  KEY move is fixing cand_0003's own over-firing rule (a regression-in-waiting), plus the recalc
  consolidation. If this rejects, the remaining failing set is dominated by inconsistent-gold tasks
  that no prose can flip — the next lever would have to be outside prose (deterministic enforcement),
  and the run may be near its prose ceiling (~0.70).
- Focus next iteration: after re-score, confirm Edit 1 flipped 325-44/30709 and Edit 2 flipped
  56996/53367; if Edit 3's float rule didn't move 56427, the reader needs a worked int-vs-float
  example rather than the abstract bullet.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.640 Δ=-0.020 · fixed={11842, 30709} · broke={38332, 50630, 73-45}. — its WHOLE batch was reverted; re-introduce only the edits that did NOT break a task above, dropping/redesigning the ones that did.
<!-- cand_0004: rejected val=0.640 Δ=-0.020 -->

<!-- cap-evolve:journal-append-below — add your Iteration entry under this line; do not edit anything above it -->

## Iteration cand_0005 — NO edit shipped: proven prose ceiling, full evidence map handed back
- Changes I made: NONE. prompt.md and task_template.md left byte-identical to cand_0003. After a
  full diagnosis of all 17 failing tasks, no candidate edit passes REAL+SAFE+VERIFIED, so per the
  instructions ("a hard zero does not move on emphasis"; drop every edit that fails a test) I ship
  nothing rather than a neutral/hopeful edit that would only add variance around the significance
  margin (and risk flaky 73-45).
- Why no edit is safe+real+verified (evidence in PROCESS.md, per task):
  - Class 1 INCONSISTENT/HAND-AUTHORED GOLD (9): 51359 (byte-identical input → gold 4 vs 7 —
    provably impossible), 5192 (self-contradictory example), 3911/39046 (inconsistent hand-filled
    helpers, already 2/3), 55931 (human-entered "manual" values), 57090 (undefined dedup + corrupt
    header), 325-44 (static Output across copies; type signal contradicts the regression-protected
    "extracts stay str" rule and wouldn't flip it), 450-9 ('etc' junk + truncated range), 50051
    (under-determined ranking). Prose can't fix without hardcoding gold.
  - Class 2 BEHAVIORAL value/logic despite HAVING the rule (6): 56637 (invented ROUNDUP), 59743
    (invented F−J branch), 56996, 11842, 57232, 56427. Out of scope for prose per the system-prompt
    SKILL.
  - Class 3 TRAP (30709): any type-flip discriminator re-breaks passing 50630/38332; likely
    unwinnable anyway (per-copy date-parse inconsistency).
- Building on prior RESULTS / refuted this iteration (do NOT re-try):
  - cand_0004 REJECTED broke={38332,50630,73-45}: its Edit 1 (keyword-triggered split→typed
    exception) re-breaks 50630 ("DATE" in NOTE/headers) + 38332 ("count" ×3). Never key a type rule
    on a word appearing in instruction/headers/source. CONFIRMED by reading both passing traces.
  - NEW definitive refutation: cand_0004 Edit 2 (recalc consolidation) DID land — its 56996 rollout
    writes a live `=VLOOKUP(...,$B$8:$H$12,MATCH($C$4,$B$7:$H$7,0),FALSE)` instead of a literal — yet
    still 0/3, because the VLOOKUP hardcodes preview-copy ranges. So 56996 is a hardcoded-range/logic
    error, NOT a literalization gap; re-adding the recalc correction fixes nothing (helps no other
    failing task either). Verified against run_suite/rollouts/val/56996__cand_0004__t0.json.
  - cand_0004 Edit 3 (float-type match): entangled with the 38332 int→float regression; flips no
    failing task (56427's example type is copy-dependent; 57232/325-44 dominated by logic). Dropped.
  - Also honored: no prompt.md anti-fabrication prose (broke 50051, cand_0001); no global
    "text→plain string" rule (broke 73-45, cand_0001/0002); no MORE type-contract prose (plateaued
    per cand_0003).
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked + why prose can't: the entire failing set. Class 1 needs
  corrected gold; Class 2 needs deterministic enforcement of "reproduce every pre-filled
  worked-example value before finalizing" + "never hardcode a preview range" (would flip 56637,
  59743, 56996, and help 11842/57232/56427). Class 3 has no safe discriminator.
- Plateau signal: STRONG. cand_0003 (+0.060) was the last real gain; cand_0004 (-0.020) proved the
  type/recalc/float prose levers regress. The lever must switch OFF prose — to deterministic
  behavioral enforcement (out of this capability's edit space) — or the run is at its ceiling (~0.66)
  on this val set until benchmark gold is corrected.
- Focus next iteration: do NOT re-test type/recalc/float prose. If a non-prose lever becomes
  available, target the Class-2 behavioral cluster (worked-example reconciliation + no hardcoded
  ranges). Otherwise treat 0.66 as the val ceiling.
